departments.name: Water Resources & Supply Board
departments.description: Responsible for municipal drinking water supply, pipeline maintenance, leakages, and water meter operations.

departments.name: Electricity Distribution Corporation
departments.description: Oversees grid reliability, power outages, damaged transformers, live wires, and street lighting.

departments.name: Public Works & Road Infrastructure
departments.description: Maintains public roads, bridges, potholes, footpaths, signals, and civic constructions.

departments.name: Municipal Sanitation & Waste Management
departments.description: Handles daily garbage collection, overflowing dumps, hazardous waste, and public hygiene.

departments.name: Public Health & Safety Department
departments.description: Monitors vector control, water contamination, disease outbreaks, and food safety inspections.

departments.name: Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs
departments.description: Manages fair price shops, ration card issues, grain quality, and distribution grievances.

departments.name: General Municipal Administration
departments.description: Coordinates cross-departmental civic services, drainage, transport coordination, and manual triage.

categories.name: Water Supply and Leakage
categories.description: Pipeline leaks, no drinking water supply, contaminated tap water, or low pressure.

categories.name: Electricity and Streetlights
categories.description: Power outages, blown transformers, flickering/broken streetlights, hanging or sparking wires.

categories.name: Roads, Potholes and Public Infrastructure
categories.description: Potholes, broken roads, damaged pavements, hazardous road cave-ins, and unfinished construction.

categories.name: Sanitation and Garbage
categories.description: Uncollected trash heaps, overflowing public dumpsters, dead animals, and illegal dumping.

categories.name: Drainage and Flooding
categories.description: Blocked storm drains, open manholes, sewage overflows onto streets, and waterlogging.

categories.name: Public Health and Safety
categories.description: Mosquito breeding, stagnant contaminated pools, stray animal bites, food poisoning risks.

categories.name: Public Distribution System / Ration Services
categories.description: Ration shop irregularities, biometric failure, denied quota, poor grain quality, or closure during working hours.

categories.name: Public Transport
categories.description: Bus frequency delays, broken bus shelters, reckless driving, or route cancellation.

categories.name: Municipal Services
categories.description: Trade licenses, birth/death certificate delays, property tax assessment issues, encroachment.

categories.name: Other / Needs Review
categories.description: Unclassified grievances requiring manual triage by administrative officers.
